check.q: Before submitting a village scholarship table, how should numeric ID columns be verified?

opts.t: Cross-check digit count and checksum totals against source forms

opts.m: Single-digit ID errors block student scholarship disbursements.

w2.title: Worked Example 2: Spreadsheet Formulas: SUM, AVERAGE & COUNTIF
w2.question: Five learners scored 18, 20, 16, 22, and 24 coins. Find the sum and average.

check.q: Every formula in a standard spreadsheet cell must begin with which symbol?

opts.m: Without '=', the cell treats the text as a plain label.

w3.title: Worked Example 3: Offline Backup & PIN-Guarded Store Reconciliation
w3.question: A student has 80 Aasha Coins and redeems a notebook worth 50 Coins. What balance remains?

steps.text: Verify initial wallet balance = 80 Coins ≥ item cost (50 Coins).
Record transaction in the append-only store ledger.

check.q: Why must wallet redemptions check `balance >= cost` before deducting coins?

opts.t: To enforce coin conservation and prevent negative balances

opts.m: XP and mastery stay intact; only spendable coins are deducted.
